name: good
subject: Application for Data & Analytics Opportunities
body:
Dear {Name},

I hope this message finds you well. I am Pranav Shrivastav, a B.Tech student in Computer Science with a keen interest in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, and Data Science. I am writing to express my interest in any suitable opportunities at {Company}.

Over the course of my studies I have built hands-on skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI, and have worked on several machine learning projects as part of my coursework and personal exploration. I am eager to apply these skills in a practical setting where I can contribute meaningfully while continuing to grow.

Please find my resume attached for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background might be a good fit for {Company}.

Best regards,
Pranav Shrivastav
